outcome_evidence: The oven door is open initially (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the door, then raises it toward the oven front during frames 80–90 (image and left_ego_image). The door is visibly closed by frame 91 and remains closed after the gripper withdraws through frame 132 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt, unintended object displacement, or harmful side effect is visible.
